scope: M1-A only; proposed review data, no active gameplay, no canonical new actor, no approved prose schema or real receipts.
rules: Read, select, change selection and status do not commit effects. Continue only submits opaque prepared choice identity under the D2/D6 privacy amendment.
Trusted authority provides already authorized committed facts, not client input or global diagnostics. Fact names below are candidate semantic projection terms, not approved shared schema.

Technical pending boundary cannot render a terminal outcome. Actual interruption can render partial progress. Resume requires a new eligible choice after interruption. Never infer total elapsed duration from just the last boundary.

Do not imply a named NPC is present, employed, willing, related to the player, knows access details or is the player's caretaker unless explicitly established. NPC-0001 is source-role reference only. Inquiry requires actual visible contact and opportunity to ask, not a guarantee of an answer. A refusal requires an authorized observed response; absence is not a refusal.
Rest requires an actual safe permitted location and elapsed eligible rest. Do not imply sleep, improved HP, restored needs, resources or skill unless separately authorized effects establish them.

Rendering accepts only current actor/world/epoch scoped committed receipts and recognized content version; use stable receipt/paragraph identity, ordered authorized prefix and deterministic versioned text. No old-epoch append, duplicate segment or RNG use. All actual storage/auth rules remain pending.

Present choices from actual feasible authorized context, not a scripted successor list. The sample path list below specifies test intentions only. Preserve necessary travel and routine rest; nonroutine repeat suggestions require material context change; no automatic relationship gain.

rows.clarification: Willingness to engage is not consent to disclose or a predetermined answer. If no authorized opportunity to ask, do not show the row.

variants: You make some progress toward the lobby before you have to stop. The rest of the route is still ahead of you.
You stop partway along the route. You have not reached the lobby, and the remaining distance is still to be covered.
You reach the building lobby. The route from the landing is complete.
The last part of the route brings you into the lobby. Your next action depends on what is available here.
You ask about access to the building and receive an answer. The information you have been given is now part of what you know about the building.
You raise the question of building access. The answer gives you information to consider before you decide what to do next.
templates.required_followup: Display exact authorized attributed answer content separately from established world truth; no answer text generated here.

variants: You ask about building access. The reply addresses only part of your question, leaving the rest unresolved.
Your question receives a partial answer. You have some information to work with, but you still do not have a complete answer.
templates.required_followup: Display actual attributed partial claim and known unresolved portion if available.

variants: You ask about access to the building, but the question is left for another time. You have no new answer to act on.
The discussion does not settle the question of access. An answer has been deferred, and you can consider the options still available to you.
You ask about building access. The person declines to answer, so you leave the exchange without the information you sought.
Your question is met with a refusal. You have no new answer about building access, and the decision of what to do next remains yours.
You spend some time resting in the place available to you. The rest interval comes to an end.
You take the opportunity to rest. When the allotted interval has passed, you can decide what to do next.
You begin to rest, but the interval is interrupted. Only the time you have actually spent resting has passed.
Your rest ends before the intended interval is complete. You have not finished the rest you set out to take.
